title: The models for analyzing and evaluating the financial assets 1

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply mean-variance models to analyze and select investment portfolios.
Use CAPM to estimate expected returns on assets and portfolios.
Apply multi-factor models to estimate expected returns and identify arbitrage opportunities.
Develop models for investment selection and financial asset valuation.
Estimate and test models for financial asset valuation.
Analyze risk management strategies in financial markets.
Develop self-learning abilities and independent work habits.
Work effectively in teams and take responsibility for individual and group performance.
Use Excel for financial modeling and analysis.
Use R for statistical analysis and financial modeling.
